resources.string: Configure a general-purpose AI service (OpenAI-compatible API). Upcoming features such as reading Q&A will use this configuration. It is separate from the AI translation settings.
Saving these settings means you agree to have the content you enter sent to the configured service. Usage costs are billed to that service account.

Check the base URL and model name; HTTP must be explicitly allowed.
